purpose: Persist an idempotent receiver-side receipt for a future GT bridge.
authority: separate OC receiver journal with its own writer lock and CURRENT.receiver checksum
idempotency: same request UUID and exact payload returns the original durable receipt; a conflicting payload is rejected
failurePolicy: partial write, rename, directory sync and pre-ack faults fence the writer; reopen reads only CURRENT.receiver and never guesses from pending files
custody: STAGED_NONSPENDABLE; the receipt does not create GT inventory, clear OC reservation, or authorize CONFIRM
promotionGate: real Forge registry identity and unit conversion reviewed
receiver is installed in the actual server world and its save authority is identified
OC-side ProductExport and receiver receipt are explicitly reconciled
rollback and uncertain call policy is tested on the real deployment
